ask: Why is it on the path?
cards: The revolution of 1868 that ended the Tokugawa shogunate, restored direct imperial rule and launched Japan's rapid modernisation.
Begun by the Katipunan in 1896 against Spanish rule, it declared independence on 12 June 1898, but Spain then ceded the islands to the United States.
Merchants, clergy and reformers forced the Qajar shah to grant a constitution and an elected parliament, the Majlis, in 1906.
A mutiny at Wuchang in 1911 spread from province to province until the boy emperor Puyi abdicated and the Republic of China was founded.
A secular national republic in place of the Ottoman Empire: the caliphate abolished, the Latin alphabet adopted, the vote given to women.
After Japan's surrender in 1945 the Viet Minh took power across Vietnam, and Ho Chi Minh proclaimed the Democratic Republic on 2 September.
Sukarno proclaimed independence in August 1945; after two Dutch offensives, international pressure brought the Netherlands to recognise it in 1949.
The Communists under Mao Zedong defeated the Nationalists and proclaimed the People's Republic of China in October 1949.
Mass protests and strikes drove the shah out of Iran in January 1979, and Khomeini returned to found the Islamic Republic.
